patterns: APPSC repeatedly asks the first World Telugu Conference year (1975) and later conferences' venues.
Telugu Sahitya Akademi award winners (poet-for-year) and institution inaugurators (Ravindra Bharathi) are APPSC favourites.
Year-of-founding items for AP institutions (AP Sahitya Akademi 1957, ITI 1975, Telugu University 1985) fit the single-fact style.
Many filed PYQs are generic national awards GK, not AP culture; the app correctly focuses on AP newspapers, Nandi awards, Telugu Phalke awardees.
